title: Coordinate projection sup norm bound
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, define its coordinate projection at $x\in\Omega^n$ by averaging $f$ over an independent uniform-product draw on the coordinates outside $J$, while using $x$ on $J$. The absolute value of this projection at every $x$ is at most $\max_{y\in\Omega^n}|f(y)|$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
